items.information:
This competition is organized by the Cubing Club at UVU. Membership is open to both UVU and non-UVU students. For more details, visit the [Cubing Club at UVU tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UtahSnowballBash2025#59029-cubing-club-at-uvu).

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). 

Go to our [website](utahcubing.org) to find links to our Facebook group , Instagram page, and website, as well as the Rockies Discord Server, to be notified when local competitions are announced and to keep in touch with cubers in the area!

venue.details: A competição acontecerá no ginásio. Basta seguir reto pela esquerda até o fim e virar à direita. O porteiro está auxiliando também.

items.information:
**(Português) Brasileiro**
É com grande alegria que anunciamos mais um Capivara!

Esse ano, estamos testando pela primeira vez um dia apenas para modalidades silenciosas, e o segundo dia para as modalidades mais populares. Então pedimos para prestar bastante atenção às modalidades em que você está se inscrevendo.

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição" (e na hora da inscrição). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=hfp2rKaN8jHPI_RL).

É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, que podem ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/).

Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Feminino' e 'Iniciante', que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'.

**English**
It is in great excitement that we announce a new Capivara!

This year, we are testing for the first time one day exclusively to silent events, and the second day for the most popular events. Therefore, we ask you to pay a lot of attention to the events you are registering to.

Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements" (and during the registration). If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4yo7IqbcgOA).

It is very important that you know the regulations, which may be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Female' and 'Beginner', which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

items.name: Texas Championship 2025
items.information:
This competition is supported by [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/) as the Texas State Championship for 2025 - We're excited to bring speedcubing back to The Heart of Texas for the 4th annual Texas Championship!
While only residents of Texas are eligible for the title of Texas State Champion, all competitors are welcome and encouraged to compete! More information can be found on the [Texas Champion Titles tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TexasChampionship2025#58131-texas-champion-titles).

All competitors must read the [Important Information/FAQ tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TexasChampionship2025#58127-important-information-faq) prior to registering.

Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TexasChampionship2025#competition-schedule) is tentative - we may adjust the exact starting time of each event based on the final number of registered competitors.

To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
